value.0: Hi. Are you looking for a little job ? Then you came to the right person. I can need your help if you want to show me your abilities.
Congratulations ! You have well accomplished that mission. Here is your reward.
Are you sure you want to cancel that mission ?
The mission is now registered in your journal.
Sorry, you already have the max number of missions you can take from me.
No, I want to cancel one of my missions.
Yes I want a mission. How can I help you ?
